purpose: Minimal governed classification knowledge objects: classification_system -> classification_version -> code -> official_label -> scope/exclusions. Distinct from concept, lexeme, and statistical-product-grouping objects. Only what Pilot 01 needs.

record_schema.one_owner_note: A classification object does NOT carry source_id directly (source_id is forbidden). One fact -> one owner: the source binding lives on the classification EVIDENCE record (main/data/evidence/EVD-*.json), and the classification object references it via supporting_evidence_ids. supporting_evidence_ids resolves to classification-kind evidence records; an empty list means the classification IDENTITY is not (yet) supported by admitted evidence (e.g. an unproven/blocked mapping).

HS-side identity is ADMITTED (evidence EVD-HS2022-2503-00; admissible=TRUE, evidence_sufficient) — not merely asserted; not source-locked and not published.

Source binding lives on the evidence record, not here (one-fact-one-owner).

locator.note: The report presents 'Soufres bruts et non raffinés' as a produit-remarquable statistical line; it does NOT print an SH code.

classifications.attestation_note: supporting_evidence_ids is EMPTY on purpose: no admitted CLASSIFICATION-kind evidence supports this grouping's classification identity. The label's EXISTENCE as an official statistical line is separately attested by the trade evidence EVD-MA-SULFUR-IMPORT-2024 (quantitative, not classification), but that does not establish a classification code or an HS mapping. Classification identity therefore stays UNPROVEN.
classifications.mapping_status: UNPROVEN / BLOCKED (hypothesis-only): the exact Moroccan national SH code and the official mapping of this produit-remarquable label to HS were NOT acquired (douane.gov.ma tariff endpoints are WAF/access-restricted; no login workaround per policy). The label text ('bruts et non raffinés' = crude and unrefined) is CONSISTENT with HS 2503 scope, but this correspondence remains UNPROVEN — a hypothesis, not an official mapping. supporting_evidence_ids is empty (no admitted classification evidence).
classifications.object_grouping_note: Treated as a statistical product grouping (produit remarquable), NOT confirmed as a single HS commodity. HS6 and any national code are kept as distinct nullable fields and must never be conflated.
